prompts.landscape:
Use case: stylized-concept. Create a highly refined original Chinese poetic character-and-landscape illustration, vertical 2:3 artwork for a premium mobile character reveal and collectible art print. Art only, NOT a UI screenshot, no text, letters, seals containing characters, numbers, watermarks or logo.
Subject: an imagined Li Bai, an elegant mature East Asian poet about 35-45 with fine short moustache and subtle goatee, handsome thoughtful face, long dark hair tied in a loose Tang-inspired topknot. Ivory flowing scholar robes with muted jade layers, tiny restrained vermilion sash. Seen in three-quarter profile, gazing toward distant dawn, poised on a wet riverside rock. The near full figure occupies approximately 70% of image height and sits right of center (head near x66%, y25%; robe hem near y83%). Expressive sculptural fabric, anatomically coherent neck and shoulders. One hand rests naturally against a rolled poetry scroll at waist; other hand hidden naturally in sleeve. No sword and no armor.
Scene: immense blue-green mineral-pigment mountains receding into luminous warm mist, a winding jade river and tiny distant sail suggesting boundless travel, foreground dark pine needles and river reeds entering the lowest corners. Strong near/mid/far atmospheric layers. Morning light from upper-left illuminates the face and ivory robes; the same light catches wet rocks and drifting mist. Figure must be painted as part of the scene, never a cutout floating on background.
Composition safety: quiet pale mist in left 30% above y65%, reserved for live vertical name and two poetry lines. Top 10% is breathable sky. Keep head, hands and robe hem fully within frame. Bottom 14% subtly dissolves into deep mineral teal and mist, low detail and text-safe; no important anatomy here.
Medium: lavish hand-painted fine brushwork, exquisite facial modeling, Gongbi-informed silk and mineral pigment texture with cinematic spatial depth, contemporary gallery-quality Eastern narrative painting, luminous restrained color. Not flat vector, not paper collage, not anime, not 3D render. Original character design and composition, no resemblance to a specific franchise or existing painting.
prompts.cabinet:
Use case: stylized-concept. Create a premium original Eastern fantasy character collectible art illustration, portrait 2:3. Art only, not an interface mockup. No readable text, symbols resembling letters, numerals, logos, watermarks or fake rarity labels.
Subject: imagined Li Bai as a charismatic mature East Asian wandering poet, age around 35-45, confident contemplative face, refined short moustache and goatee, long black hair in Tang-inspired half-up topknot. Ivory silk outer robe, midnight indigo and peacock teal inner folds, exquisitely embroidered restrained gold cloud motifs, one fine vermilion silk accent. Large central three-quarter to knee-up portrait, head at x50%, y25%, shoulders spanning x22%-78%, lower drapery extending to y77%. Face must be richly resolved and immediately focal at phone scale. One natural hand at chest gently holds a small plain jade wine cup with believable five-finger anatomy; the other is hidden under drapery. No sword, armor, combat, or specific game costume.
Scene/composition: deep nocturnal cobalt blue, faint distant clouds and ocean, sculptural circular antique-gold lunar astrolabe behind shoulders, asymmetrical orbit of fine silk ribbons and wisps of ink vapor. A warm moon glow provides coherent rimlight; warm facial light and cool blue reflected silk shadows. Foreground deep blue silk mist partially overlaps lower robe. Rich depth and material contrast.
Collectible art language: extremely delicate original archaic cloud-and-river engraving only along the outermost 4% edge and top corners, like a crafted museum object, integrated into the art, never ordinary rounded cards or UI panels. Do not copy any game character, emblem or interface. The circle is behind the character, not across their face. Keep head and hands clear from ornament.
Reserve lower 23% as calm deep midnight ink with subtle gold dust, empty enough for a live Chinese name, title and two horizontal poetry lines; keep important anatomy out of this area. Top 8% breathing room. All head and visible hands inside canvas, no accidental crop.
Style: extraordinary hand-painted Eastern fantasy key art, painterly realism, fine textile detail, sophisticated adult beauty, bold near/far contrast. Not glossy plastic, not chibi, not flat vector or a generic tarot template. Original polished collectible illustration.
